turns.prompt: the Save button on the create form is cut off on my phone. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
I made a fix, but I couldn't test it on a phone, so I don't know for sure it solves what you're seeing.

**What I changed:**
- `templates/bootstrap4/admin/lib.html`: the Save / Save and Add Another / Save and Continue Editing / Cancel row had the class `col-md-offset-2`. That's a Bootstrap 3 class and does nothing in the Bootstrap 4.6 these templates use. I took it out along with `col-md-10`, so the row is just `submit-row` now.
- `static/admin/css/bootstrap4/admin.css`: the button row on the full-page form, and the footer of the create/edit popups, now wrap onto a new line on a narrow screen instead of running off the edge. Each button is capped at the screen width, and long labels like "Save and Continue Editing" can break onto two lines inside the button.

The CSS link in `base.html` still says `v='1.1.1'`. Your phone may keep showing the old cached stylesheet, so hard-refresh or clear the cache before you test.

If it's still cut off, tell me whether it's the full Create page or the popup. Also say whether the problem is the button going off the side of the screen or sitting under the browser's bottom bar. The bottom bar would be a different problem from the one I fixed.

I've made a second fix, but this one is untested too since I have no phone or browser here. My best guess at the real cause is a leftover Bootstrap 3 workaround in `admin.css`. It forced the page behind the "Create New Record" popup to scroll. On a phone, swiping then scrolls that background page instead of the popup, so you can never reach the bottom of a tall form, which is where Save sits. That would look exactly like the button being cut off, and the wrapping change I made last time wouldn't touch it.

**What I changed:**
- **`static/admin/css/bootstrap4/admin.css`:** removed that workaround, so the popup itself is what scrolls on touch screens again. The comment on it already said it could probably go once they moved past Bootstrap 3.3.5, and they're on 4.6.2 now.
- **`templates/bootstrap4/admin/base.html`:** changed the stylesheet version from `v='1.1.1'` to `v='1.1.2'`. That forces your phone to download the new CSS instead of using the cached copy, which may also be why the first fix seemed to do nothing.

The workaround was originally there to stop the left edge of select2 dropdowns getting clipped inside popups. On desktop, check that dropdowns in the create popup still look right.

If Save is still cut off, tell me:
1. Is it the full Create page or the popup?
2. Can you scroll down to Save at all, or is it hidden behind the browser's bottom bar?
3. Is the button running off the right side of the screen?

A screenshot would settle it faster.

I still can't see the bug, so I'm not going to send a third guess. Both fixes so far were blind, and I haven't confirmed the cause.

**What I tried this time:** I wanted to load the Create page at iPhone width and measure where Save actually lands. Two things blocked me:
- **Running the real app:** it needs `wtforms`, which isn't installed. Installing it needs PyPI, and that connection was denied when I asked for it.
- **Rendering a copy instead:** I built a static copy of the Create page and popup, using the repo's own Bootstrap and `admin.css`, and wrote a script to measure the buttons at 375px wide. The sandbox wouldn't let a browser start: both Chrome and Playwright's Chromium were refused at the macOS level. That's a sandbox setting, and changing it is your call.

**Fastest ways forward, pick one:**
1. **Tell me what you see.** Is it the full Create page or the "Create New Record" popup? Is Save off the right edge, or below the bottom where you can't scroll to it? A screenshot would settle it.
2. **Run my check yourself.** Run this in your own terminal, outside the sandbox:
   ```
   python3 /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-USER-Desktop-exp1-work-runs--work-10ca1c1496-repo/4937b5ff-8fd4-423d-9843-1a8e1b1dee11/scratchpad/check.py /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-USER-Desktop-exp1-work-runs--work-10ca1c1496-repo/4937b5ff-8fd4-423d-9843-1a8e1b1dee11/scratchpad/page.html
   ```
   Paste me what it prints. It also saves a screenshot next to the page file.
3. **Let me install packages.** Allow PyPI so I can install `wtforms` and run the real app.

One caveat on option 2: it's a hand-built copy with plain text fields. If your form has dropdowns (select2) or a custom layout, it may not show the bug. Option 1 or 3 would tell us more.

My changes from the last two rounds are still in place: the button row wraps, the old scrolling workaround is gone, and the stylesheet version is bumped. Say the word if you want any of them reverted.
